chain.title: Your subcontractors' hours, on your timesheet
chain.subtitle: Hand work to another company and keep seeing it. The hours their people log flow straight into your records — no spreadsheets passed back and forth, no waiting until invoicing to find out what happened.
chain.oneBody: Assign work to a partner company the same way you assign it to your own team. They receive it as their own job, linked back to yours.
chain.twoBody: The partner puts their own people on it — or delegates further down the chain. Up to five levels deep, each company managing its own workforce.
chain.threeBody: Every hour logged anywhere in the chain lands on your timesheet, ready for approval and payroll. You see the work, not just the invoice.
chain.privacyBody: Delegating shows you progress, not personnel. Their employees' details stay theirs — unless they choose to join your project and put their people on it. Consent is an explicit act by the other company, never a side effect of the contract.
